Featured Projects

A selection of our recent property development, construction and property service projects across London and the Home Counties.

Residential Design & Build

Comprehensive demolition and redevelopment of a former gas reduction facility, transforming the site from a single national utility structure into Prestige House, a collection of nine high-specification apartments (five one-bedroom and four two-bedroom) in Catford, South London. The scheme combined part demolition and conversion of the original building with a new three-storey L-shaped block, including piled foundations, and was completed and signed off by building control in May 2022 with a 10-year structural warranty.

Part demolition, conversion and new build creating nine high-spec apartments.
Catford, Lewisham, London

Vertical Extension - 4 Penthouses

Construction of 4 new penthouse flats on the roof of a 24-flat 1930s mansion block in Cricklewood, with all residents in occupation throughout. Two new lifts were installed in the altered original shafts, staircases were extended to the new floor, and a separate Section 20 programme refurbished the communal areas, facade and electrical infrastructure under the managing agent and surveyor. JCT contract, completed 2017.

Vertical extension and construction of four penthouse flats.
Cricklewood, London NW2

HMO Conversion

Victorian property on Finchley Road, Hampstead, converted into a high-specification nine-bedroom HMO, combining original character with modern living standards. Each bedroom is designed as a private suite, featuring an en-suite bathroom and a compact kitchenette, providing both independence and comfort. Two communal kitchens, located on the ground and top floors, offer additional shared space for residents. The layout has been carefully planned to maximise space, functionality, and compliance with all current HMO and building regulations, resulting in a well-balanced and efficient multi-occupancy residence in a prime Hampstead location. Building control final certificate issued August 2024.

HMO conversion with en-suite rooms, kitchenettes and shared facilities.
Hampstead, London

HMO Conversion

Conversion and full refurbishment of a property in Acton, West London, into a high-specification licensed six-bedroom HMO. Works started in March 2026 and were completed in October 2026. Works included new FD30 fire doors with intumescent seals and self-closers, a fully designed and commissioned fire alarm with emergency lighting and escape signage, a new three-phase electrical supply and consumer unit, new flooring and redecoration throughout. Building control final certificate issued November 2026.

HMO conversion with fire doors, fire alarm and emergency lighting, electrical upgrade, flooring and decoration.
Acton, London

Student Accommodation - Mercia Lodge

Design and build conversion of the unused second floor of a former Travelodge hotel in Coventry city centre into 19 self-contained student rooms, taking the building to 169 rooms. Works included heavy demolition of the old kitchen and cold rooms, 21 new roof lights cut through the concrete roof on new steelwork, metal stud partitions, new hot and cold water and drainage for every room, and active smoke ventilation linked to the fire alarm. Delivered to a fixed deadline for student arrivals, with the building control final certificate issued August 2016.

Student accommodation upgrade and refurbishment works.
Coventry, West Midlands

Luxury Basement Conversion

A stunning basement conversion in central London featuring a cinema room, gym, and wine cellar with full waterproofing and natural light solutions.

Basement construction, waterproofing and premium internal finishes.
Kensington, London

High-End Double Storey Side Extension Design & Build

A high-quality double storey side extension combined with a full internal refurbishment, transforming the property into a modern, spacious home. The project included structural expansion, redesigned layouts, upgraded electrics and plumbing, and premium finishes throughout.

Double-storey extension, structural alterations and full internal refurbishment.
Elstree

Mixed-Use Development

Construction of 2 flats and 1 commercial building in the busy Bow area of East London, managing logistics to ensure minimal disruption.

Mixed-use construction including residential and commercial space.
Bow, London

Commercial Build & Conversion

Refurbishment of commercial space in Mayfair, incorporating structural alteration, extension and comprehensive refurbishment. The project reflects a strong emphasis on design integration, build quality and asset value.

Commercial refurbishment, structural alteration and fit-out works.
Mayfair, London

Suburban Residential Development Pipeline 2026-2027

A residential redevelopment in St Albans, currently in the planning and pre-construction stage for delivery in 2026 to 2027.

Residential redevelopment in a suburban and semi-rural setting.
St Albans

Smart Environment Group

Smart Environment Group has been developing, building and maintaining property across London and the Home Counties since 2009. Three teams work under one roof: development, construction and property services. That means one group can take a project from purchase and planning, through the build, to long-term maintenance.

Our work runs from new-build apartments, HMO conversions and student accommodation to planned and responsive repairs. Clients include General Projects, MHA London and Merhav Capital. Between 2023 and 2026 our team also completed more than 460 repairs for housing associations including Notting Hill Genesis, L&Q, Peabody, Sovereign Network Group and Home Group.
